classification.difficultyReason: Identify equal angles in intersecting and nested triangles, match corresponding sides and form a proportion; the hardest part requires expressing the whole side as 4+x before solving. Similarity and the required proof-and-ratio procedure are explicitly prompted.

content.prompt: Prove that the two triangles in each diagram are similar. Then write a ratio statement and find the value of the pronumeral.

spec.description: Intersecting straight segments AE and BD, with outer joins AB and DE; both supplied 30-degree labels retained.
spec.mathematics: AB=12, BC=8, CE=6, DE=x; angle ABC=angle CED=30 degrees.

answer.worked:
$\angle ABC=\angle DEC=30^\circ$ (given), and $\angle ACB=\angle DCE$ (vertically opposite angles at $C$).

Therefore $\triangle BCA\sim\triangle ECD$ (AAA).

Matching sides give
$$\begin{align*}\frac{DE}{BA}&=\frac{EC}{BC}\\\frac{x}{12}&=\frac{6}{8}\\x&=12\times\frac{6}{8}\\x&=9.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two right triangles on one straight baseline QRS, with matching marked angles at R.
spec.mathematics: PR=9, QR=6, RS=9, RT=x; right angles at Q and S; angle PRQ=angle TRS.

answer.worked:
$\angle PRQ=\angle TRS$ (given), and $\angle PQR=\angle TSR=90^\circ$ (given).

Therefore $\triangle PQR\sim\triangle TSR$ (AAA).

Matching sides give
$$\begin{align*}\frac{TR}{PR}&=\frac{SR}{QR}\\\frac{x}{9}&=\frac{9}{6}\\x&=9\times\frac{9}{6}\\x&=\frac{27}{2}=13\tfrac12.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: AD and BC intersect at M; AB and CD are vertical parallel sides with matching arrows.
spec.mathematics: AB=5, BM=3, MC=7, CD=x; AB parallel CD.

answer.worked:
$\angle AMB=\angle DMC$ (vertically opposite angles at $M$), and $\angle ABM=\angle DCM$ (alternate angles, $AB\parallel CD$).

Therefore $\triangle AMB\sim\triangle DMC$ (AAA).

Matching sides give
$$\begin{align*}\frac{DC}{AB}&=\frac{MC}{MB}\\\frac{x}{5}&=\frac{7}{3}\\x&=5\times\frac{7}{3}\\x&=\frac{35}{3}=11\tfrac23.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Nested triangles KPM and LQM with Q on PM, L on KM and PK parallel QL.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; the total PM is not supplied in the diagram.

answer.worked:
$\angle KMP=\angle LMQ$ (common angle), and $\angle KPM=\angle LQM$ (corresponding angles, $KP\parallel LQ$).

Therefore $\triangle KPM\sim\triangle LQM$ (AAA).

$PM=PQ+QM=1+7=8$.

Matching sides give
$$\begin{align*}\frac{LQ}{KP}&=\frac{QM}{PM}\\\frac{x}{4}&=\frac{7}{8}\\x&=4\times\frac{7}{8}\\x&=\frac72=3\tfrac12.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Joined right triangles PRQ and QRS share RQ; the 60-degree label lies in triangle PRQ.
spec.mathematics: PR=x, RQ=1, RS=2; angle RPQ=angle RQS=90 degrees, angle PRQ=60 degrees, angle QSR=30 degrees.

answer.worked:
$\angle QRS=180^\circ-90^\circ-30^\circ=60^\circ$ (angle sum of a triangle).

Thus $\angle PRQ=\angle QRS=60^\circ$, and $\angle RPQ=\angle RQS=90^\circ$.

Therefore $\triangle PRQ\sim\triangle QRS$ (AAA).

Matching sides give
$$\begin{align*}\frac{PR}{QR}&=\frac{RQ}{RS}\\\frac{x}{1}&=\frac{1}{2}\\x&=\frac12.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Nested right triangles ABD and ACE, with D on AE, B on AC and DB parallel EC.
spec.mathematics: AB=4, BC=x, DB=6, EC=10; angle EAC=90 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; AC is not labelled with its calculated value.

answer.worked:
$\angle DAB=\angle EAC$ (common angle), and $\angle ADB=\angle AEC$ (corresponding angles, $DB\parallel EC$).

Therefore $\triangle ACE\sim\triangle ABD$ (AAA).

$AC=AB+BC=4+x$.

Matching sides give
$$\begin{align*}\frac{AC}{AB}&=\frac{CE}{BD}\\\frac{x+4}{4}&=\frac{10}{6}\\x+4&=\frac{20}{3}\\x&=\frac{20}{3}-4\\x&=\frac83=2\tfrac23.\end{align*}$$
